C1616.title: Machine Learning-Based Intrusion Detection System for False Messages in VANETs
C1616.summary: A study proposes an intrusion detection system targeting false messages in vehicular ad hoc networks. The system uses machine learning classification models trained on vehicle-to-vehicle and vehicle-to-infrastructure communication data under both attack and normal scenarios, aiming to classify received messages as genuine or false and improve false information detection accuracy.
